description.value: McDonald's on Commercial Drive sits in one of Vancouver's most lively and cyclist-travelled corridors, offering the standard quick-service menu of burgers, breakfast items, and beverages. The location has indoor seating and takeout, making it a straightforward refuelling stop for riders passing through the Drive. As a national franchise, amenity specifics vary by location and must be confirmed on the ground.
